title: Trump rejects pause in AI race citing competition from China

Understanding El Niño and why its weather disruption could break records this year
subhed: The El Niño climate anomaly, which occurs in the Pacific every two to seven years, triggers droughts and floods, disrupts entire sectors of the economy, and raises global temperatures.

title: International outcry after Russian drone strikes train near border with Poland
subhed: Ukraine denounced a 'systematic attack' on its rail network while Poland, a NATO member, said it feared 'escalation' from Russia after a drone hit a passenger train on Sunday. Another train carrying European and American dignitaries had just left the targeted station.

title: On the shores of the Strait of Hormuz, an Iranian photographer captures the lives caught between sea and fire: 'It was necessary to show what war does to them'
subhed: On the Iranian islands along this strategic passage, the war between the US and Iran has upended the lives of fishers, merchants and families connected to both shores of the Persian Gulf. The consequences are captured in photographs by one Iranian – whose identity has been concealed for security reasons.

title: As France faces populist surge, voters' desire for radical change remains ambiguous

subhed: In France's polarized political landscape, Marine Le Pen of the far-right Rassemblement National is enjoying unprecedented support, and radical left candidate Jean-Luc Mélenchon is building a strong base. title: Céline Dion returns to stage for first Paris show: 'I want to sing for you, to sing about life'

title: How 9/11 changed the far right
